name: Jiyugaoka
tagline: Shibuya in 15 minutes and Roppongi in 24 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Meguro City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 23.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 23.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.7 m to 37.3 m, a difference of 13.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: 成城石井 自由が丘店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 13 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 奥沢病院, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is おくさわ脳卒中リハビリテーション病院, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Toyoko Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Toyoko Line runs at 124% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 祐天寺→中目黒, which this station is not on. Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 九品仏→自由が丘, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Jiyugaoka.

noiseSources: The nearest big road, 自由通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
